summary: data-format-helper postinstall exfiltrates CI secrets and cloud metadata to attacker OAST endpoint
details: On npm install, postinstall.js executes a series of shell commands via child_process.exec that collect host identity (hostname, whoami/id, sudo -l, process list, network configuration), filter environment variables matching KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/NPM_TOKEN/AWS_/AZURE/GCP/GITHUB_TOKEN (including GitHub Actions variables such as GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_ACTOR, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, RUN_ID), and probe internal and cloud-metadata endpoints (tst.woa.com/flag.html, Tencent metadata, AWS 169.254.169.254, Aliyun 100.100.100.200, GCP metadata.google.internal). Collected data is base64-encoded and POSTed via curl to the hardcoded Burp Collaborator-style host pzs5w7ntzhsnepwk564lyfdci3oucl0a.oastify.com. The advertised package purpose is text sanitization / HTML-safe formatting; index.js only exports small color/number helpers unrelated to the postinstall behavior, indicating a decoy cover for the install-time exfiltration payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
